progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk5 and dwells most on Gk in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (0:14.8) introduces Eb, centred on Eb. Phrase 11 (1:30.0) introduces Ek, E, E, Gs, Ck, centred on Eb. Phrase 12 (2:22.0) introduces Bb, centred on Gs. The line peaks at Ck5 (511.3 Hz) at 1:31.0. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4).
